text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawian press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The main opposition Malawi Congress Party (MCP) has launched a legal battle for the postponement of the Blantyre City Central constituency byelection.
- Private hospitals are experiencing high influx of patients from public hospitals following the civil servants' strike now in its second week.
- The national carrier Air Malawi is considering using airforce staff because of a strike by civil servants in the Department of Civil Aviation.
- Low tobacco prices of around $1.40 per kg on the first day of tobacco sales at Lilongwe Auction Floors caused the sales to stop. Tobacco is Malawi's biggest foreign exchange earner.
